body:
FORGE FINALE -- sessions 2-3 done (loop running every 2min)

Session 2: ran the seasonality check for the first time. Real pattern in the data (busier around the London/NY overlap, quieter late at night), but correcting for it doesn't reveal a hidden edge -- if anything it slightly reinforces the existing null.

Session 3: finished mapping how the practice-run scorer differs from the live scorer (the check your Step 1 started). Found one real bug: the practice-run version is missing 3 of 5 volatility conditions -- it silently treats "elevated" and "low" volatility as neutral instead of penalizing them like the live version does. That's a genuine defect, not just a design gap, and it's a quick, safe fix (no terminal needed). Also found the "pattern" component has 3 different formulas across the file instead of 2 -- one more thing worth tidying.

Score: still 11/45 -- this was mapping/measurement work, not new criteria yet. Next up: fix the volatility bug (routine build+deploy), then check the actual search engine's scoring array directly (haven't individually verified that one yet).

Loop is still running on its own, checking in every 2 min.
